units.source_text: 据她说：今冬在滑雪场上，结识了一帮子男人，他们傍晚翻山越岭来到这里，彼此相遇，

en.t: According to her, this winter at the ski slopes she had become acquainted with a group of men, and when they crossed the mountains and came here in the evening, she ran into them,

units.source_text: 他们邀她上了客栈，还叫来艺妓，狂欢一场，被他们灌醉了。

en.t: They invited her up to the inn, called in geisha as well, made a great revel of it, and got her drunk.
